blocks.markdown: DeltaAI interactive comparison October21: user approved transferring the exact π0.5 KR checkpoint and pinned implementation. The isolated GH200120GB/PyTorch2.12 environment passed pinned π0.5 imports, actual audited train/validation two-camera decoding, BF16 cache and optimizer-continuation CPU contracts, and the two-rank coordinated-flag test. Scheduler test-only3429509 was a preflight, not a submitted job. Both cluster connections were restored. The first20,308,901,888bytes exactly matched the immutable source prefix (SHA256 b9a6df4017406a31e2ed4a08f7bfaa88916b6fbb1d1e64bdb8acc0f8d4acb6da), and the remaining transfer has resumed. The complete checkpoint is40,456,772,509bytes; its final SHA remains mandatory. The one-shot controller is waiting for a complete SHA-verified checkpoint before requesting2GH200/32CPU/256GiB for at most2hours; no GPU allocation or comparison results exist yet. Planned variants are repeated controls, CPU tokenization, transfer prefetch,12workers, autocast weight caching and disabling activation recomputation, with identical saved model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG/cursor, native global32, loss/gradient checks and15%memory headroom. Rates will be compared within the same DeltaAI allocation, not treated as a Palmetto code speedup. Production runs and the paused follow-up monitor remain unchanged. Evidence: maintenance/pi05_deltaai_comparison_20261021/status.json. Keep authenticated sessions open through staging.
